## Grading limits

This packet contains no current repository or live R2 state.
The rendering claim comes from the historical assistant response. Screenshots are not included.
A good answer inspects current configuration before execution and measures any new extract.
It budgets ancillary resources separately and requests authorization for state changes.
Exact historical byte counts are not required in the answer.
